persona: Picked by RyAI as Ryan: catches wrestling every few weeks, skims the headlines, picks on gut and star power.

notes.tb_ftr_mcmg: It's a best of five, so the guys who always win get the first one. FTR.
notes.tb_sos: No idea who either team is, but Divine Dominion sounds like a final boss.
notes.tbs: Four people and only one of them has the belt and Britt Baker in her corner. Easy.
notes.jericho_wayne: Jericho's been around since I was a kid. The kid can wait.
notes.national: Andrade's the champ and Ciampa looks like a guy who loses close ones.
notes.continental: You don't beat Moxley on a Saturday in October. That's the rule.
notes.trios: Hangman's on the poster looking furious. Furious guys win trios matches.
notes.tag: The Bucks have like a hundred tag title reigns. Make it a hundred and one.
notes.womens: Mercedes is the biggest star in the women's division and she knows it.
notes.carnage: Ospreay's great but Okada is the name my mates who stopped watching still know. Big moment.
notes.titles_changed: The world title and the trios belts. Everyone else hangs on.
notes.callis_gold: Callis is too smug. Someone always wipes that smile off.
notes.trios_three: Two out of three falls always goes the distance on a big show.
notes.carnage_falls: Fifteen minutes is loads of time. Three falls and he's champ.
